prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what you need. Do you mean best for large health systems, for physician practices, for patient acquisition, for B2B (medical device / pharma) or B2C (patient-facing), or for a small budget? Different agencies specialize in different things.

Before I recommend specific firms, tell me:
- What kind of healthcare organization are you (hospital system, clinic, specialty practice, med device company, biotech, payer, etc.)?
- Primary goals (brand awareness, patient acquisition, provider recruitment, employer/physician relations, product launch, digital transformation, content/PR, SEO/paid media)?
- Monthly/annual marketing budget range?
- Timeline and geographic reach (local St. Louis only, regional, national)?
- Any “must-haves” (HIPAA experience, EHR integrations, multilingual campaigns, creative/video, in-house analytics)?

If you want a quick checklist now, here’s how to pick the “best” agency for your needs:
- Relevant healthcare experience: HIPAA-compliant campaigns and prior work with similar organizations.
- Demonstrable results: case studies with metrics (leads, conversions, cost-per-acquisition, ROI).
- Service fit: digital (SEO/SEM), content strategy, paid social, PR, CRM/email automation, creative/video, analytics.
- Clinical/vocabulary fluency: ability to accurately represent clinical services and outcomes.
- Size and responsiveness: boutique vs full-service — which matches your level of oversight and speed requirements.
- Cultural fit: reporting cadence, project management style, approval workflows.
- References and contracts: ask for client references and sample SLAs.

If you want, I can:
- Provide a short, vetted list of St. Louis agencies known for healthcare work (and why each might fit your needs), or
- Create an RFP template and list of questions to send to agencies.

Which option would you prefer?
